mechanism: A seed page permits an exact saved Network recipe. After arming, the old page issues two real warmup fetches then a held GET /api/document-race; the saved replay reload serves a current page whose first fetch uses the identical URL, method and body. The server refuses old release before the current response or after old-client abort, and records pre-release state separately from server finish. Finish does not establish browser callback delivery.
